result:
I’d make it impossible for people to keep other human beings abstract.

Not a magical empathy spell where everyone is suddenly “nice,” but a hard, unavoidable ability to grasp the full reality of another person’s life when your choices affect them. Most harm survives because other people can be reduced to categories, statistics, enemies, costs, or inconveniences. If that reduction became mentally impossible, cruelty would lose its camouflage.
